text:
Nadia (PM): Brain dump 10m: building a recruitment + feedback lifecycle for design partners. Want something repeatable that maps asks -> roadmap bets -> launch gates. Comments inline.

Owen (Eng): Nice. Can we add a technical fit score? e.g., infra readiness (0-3), data sensitivity (0-3), latency needs (0-3). Use threshold >=6 to qualify for on-prem.

Priya (Customer Success): Also add adoption signal score: number of internal champions, expected daily active tasks, support bandwidth. We should require a named AE for >$50k ARR partners.

Diego (Research): For feedback, propose three channels: 1) structured eval runs (automated), 2) weekly 20m async notes + tags, 3) monthly synthesis call. Tagging taxonomy: regression, latency, hallucination, UX, infra.

Nadia (PM): Great. Draft recruitment form questions: company, primary use case, expected qps/seq len, data residency constraint, contact + champion, what success looks like. Keep it <=6 questions.

Eve (Legal): For on-prem we need a simple addendum: data handling, access window, ephemeral logs, and a limited support access clause. Can template it.

Ravi (Sales): Pricing plays: 1) Early partner discount (50% first 6 months) or 2) credits + success fee on rollout. Need sales approval flow in the intake form.

Owen (Eng): Operationally, installs: three-node staging image, + a healthcheck endpoint we can poll. We'll provide an automated smoke test script. Also create a `beta-ops` runbook.

Priya (Customer Success): Success criteria (to decide go/no-go): 1) partner runs our eval set end-to-end; 2) two integrations in product flows; 3) NPS >=25 from partner admins; 4) no P0s open for 2 weeks before launch.

Diego (Research): Metrics we will track automatically: avg lat, p95, token error rate, model divergence metric (against baseline), embedding similarity drift. We'll upload weekly CSVs to a shared bucket.

Nadia (PM): Prioritization rubric for feature asks during beta: Impact (0-5) * Evidence (0-3) / Effort (0-5). Use >6 as fast-track. Keep a public board.

Eve (Legal): One more ask: retention policy for logs during beta (30 days) and explicit consent for any recording sessions.

Ravi (Sales): Can we tier partners: Tier A (co-design, product mentions) + Tier B (early access) with different SLAs. Tier A gets faster bug triage and product PR mentions.

Owen (Eng): Canary plan: rollout to internal + 1 Tier A partner, monitor 72h. If key metrics hold, expand to 3 more partners. If not, rollback to previous model variant.

Priya (Customer Success): Onboarding checklist: kickoff, install validation, eval run, 1st feedback sync, success plan doc. I can own templates.

Nadia (PM): Launch gates summary:
- Technical: p95 latency within target, pass 3 smoke tests, no critical security findings.
- Product: partner adoption signals met, prioritized bugs <=5 with owners.
- Legal/Compliance: addendum signed for on-prem, retention policy OK.
- Business: sales commit to pilot pricing + AE assigned.

ci-bot: CI pipelines for `beta/eval` triggered: 12 tests passed.

Nadia (PM): Next steps: Owen to draft technical fit scoring sheet; Diego to draft tagging taxonomy; Priya to make onboarding templates; Eve to share addendum draft; Ravi to outline tier definitions. I'll consolidate into a short playbook and share Friday. Thanks all :sparkles:
